transport.title: Connection Type
transport.description: Use Legacy Tuya for older local-control RoboVacs. Use Eufy Clean Cloud for newer cloud/MQTT models.

name.title: Name
name.description: Arbitrary name for your Eufy Robovac

ip.title: IP Address
ip.description: IP Address of your Eufy Robovac. Required for Legacy Tuya 3.3 local control.

deviceKey.title: Tuya Device Key
deviceKey.description: Tuya/Eufy Device/Local Key. Required for Legacy Tuya 3.3 local control.

eufyEmail.title: Eufy Clean Email
eufyEmail.description: Eufy Clean account email. Used only for Eufy Clean cloud/MQTT mode.

eufyPassword.title: Eufy Clean Password
eufyPassword.description: Eufy Clean account password. Used only for Eufy Clean cloud/MQTT mode when no access token is supplied.

eufyAccessToken.title: Eufy Clean Access Token
eufyAccessToken.description: Optional Eufy Clean API access token.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter Eufy Clean account country code.

eufyApiBaseUrl.title: Eufy Clean API Base URL
eufyApiBaseUrl.description: Override for the Eufy Clean cloud API base URL.

mqttHost.title: MQTT Host
mqttHost.description: Eufy Clean MQTT host. Required for cloud/MQTT mode unless discovered from the cloud API.

mqttCommandTopic.title: MQTT Command Topic
mqttCommandTopic.description: Topic used to send commands to the RoboVac.

mqttStatusTopic.title: MQTT Status Topic
mqttStatusTopic.description: Topic used to receive RoboVac status updates.

roomSwitches.description: Rooms - configure according to the eufy clean app.  These are optional.  If no rooms, then the Eufy Robovac will be configured for Auto mode.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.placeholder: A room number or comma-separated list of room numbers
